limitations: Inspection evidence is a static self-attestation written at TASK-1043 commit time.
Codex performs post-commit PASS/FAIL re-verification per agent_roles.negative_tester recorded in TASK-1043.task.md.
Each check cites the source artifact in evidence_ref; cross-checks rely on the evidence anchors at HEAD 3a0b28a.
Sha prefixes are seven-to-sixteen-character prefixes recorded in source artifacts (TASK-1042 status, TASK-1042 implementation result); full hashes require git rev-parse against the working tree.
Future candidate lifecycles are advisory only; they are not authorized by TASK-1043.
